text: Workouts are easier to follow: a cleaner header, no bottom bar mid-session, a chart-first Progress page, a rest timer that tells you when rest is over, and an alternative exercise that is a real exercise with its own history.
If a set fails to save because of a bad connection, it now stays on screen with Not saved — retry, and your weight and reps are kept so you can tap again.
Personal Bests can now show the top 3 from other members. It is off until you tick the box on that page, and others only ever see a number with no name.
The recommended plan's form cues now use plain sentences with no dashes. You get them on a new plan, or when you reset to the recommended plan from Home.
New Update with AI page on Plan: copy your plan and history with a ready prompt, paste your AI's reply back, preview the changes, then confirm.
Messages stay on screen a little longer, the rest timer shows your rest time before you start it, and the warm-up hint says logged sets count.
Finish Workout now asks for a second tap, so a stray tap no longer ends your workout.
Messages and hints across the app are shorter and plainer: errors, toasts, the version banner and the recovery note.
On the Plan page, Save and Swap now say they apply to every future workout of that day, and that past workouts and history stay as they are.
You can now change the sets and reps of your plan's exercises, swap one for another, or reset the whole plan to the recommended one from Home.
The open and close arrow on workout and history rows is now a proper chevron, and the Sessions number on Progress is slightly larger.
During a workout the bottom bar no longer lights up Home, since no tab is the page you are on.
Finish Workout no longer reports an error right after an app update when the workout was in fact saved.
Tapping Log Set twice, or retrying after a bad connection, now logs the set once, and a screen reader announces each set you log.
The exercise form-cues sheet now has a Done button at the bottom you can reach with your thumb, keyboard focus stays inside the sheet, and the sets and reps labels sit above their numbers.
If you sign out while offline, the app now finishes signing you out on the server as soon as it can reach it again.
Typing a number into weight or reps no longer leaves a leading zero in front of it.
Weight and reps you enter right after opening a workout are no longer replaced by the suggested values.
Tap the version number to see what changed in recent updates.
